purpose: Events list (series, category, strike or close date) of every Mentions, Companies and Science and Technology series, for events per day. No market, price or result.
heldout: none (event metadata only: event ticker, series, category, strike or close date; no market, no price, no result)
notes: One request per series, 200 events a page, status as the probe showed; a series whose answer carries a cursor is listed apart and asked in a follow-up job.

stop_rules.note: a 429 is waited out with a doubling pause and the same request is asked again; three in a row end the run; no other address, no proxy, no retry around a refusal
